2609.24444.title: WPBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Wind Power Forecasting
2609.24444.paper_summary: Accurate, reliable, and deployable wind power forecasting is critical for power system dispatch, renewable energy integration, and electricity market operations. Progress in this field hinges on the ability to empirically and comprehensively benchmark forecasting methods. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting. WPBench integrates 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale and variable composition, spanning single-turbine, multi-turbine, univariate, and multivariate settings. Under unified processing, training, and evaluation protocols, it benchmarks 19 representative models covering traditional methods, deep temporal models, spatio-temporal models, and foundation models. Beyond point-wise errors, WPBench assesses forecast-curve fidelity and computational efficiency, and delivers structure-aware diagnostics across temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives. Together, these capabilities enable systematic model comparison across diverse wind scenarios and provide a reusable platform for future research.
2609.24444.paper_summary_zh: 準確、可靠且可部署的風力發電預測對於電力系統調度、可再生能源整合和電力市場運作至關重要。這一領域的進展依賴於能夠實證和全面地基準化預測方法。然而，現有的基準在四個關鍵方面未能支持系統評估：1）在渦輪機規模、變量組成和空間結構方面的風力發電場景覆蓋有限；2）預測模型家族的覆蓋不完整；3）評估指標與風力發電需求不一致；4）在個別時間模式之外的結構感知診斷有限。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了WPBench，一個全面、公平且可擴展的風力發電預測基準。WPBench整合了26個公共數據集，按渦輪機規模和變量組成進行組織，涵蓋單渦輪機、多渦輪機、單變量和多變量設置。在統一的處理、訓練和評估協議下，它基準化了19個代表性模型，涵蓋傳統方法、深度時間模型、時空模型和基礎模型。除了點對點的誤差外，WPBench還評估預測曲線的保真度和計算效率，並提供結構感知診斷，涵蓋時間、變量依賴和空間依賴的視角。這些能力使得在多樣的風力場景中進行系統模型比較成為可能，並為未來的研究提供了一個可重用的平台。
